AgentAccess: Invite people from the Info panel when you can manage access. Viewers can open files in Chat outputs, but they can't access the agent's chats. Check Contacts for members and roles, and History for recent activity.
AgentAccessMember: The Info panel shows who has access to the agent and which role is assigned to each person. Check History for recent activity, or contact someone with the right permissions when the setup needs a change.
AgentBuild: Choose a model, describe the agent's role and tasks, and select any available tools it needs. After creating the agent, add reference files to its Knowledge base.
AgentChat: Open AI Chat and describe what you need. Try a suggested question or write your own, then check the answer and refine your request if needed.
AgentDemoPreview: This tour uses sample agents to show how the section works. The examples are separate from your own agents.
AgentEmpty: The agents in this tour were examples. Agents appear here when someone gives you access. Open one to start working with it.
AgentEmptyTitle: Your list is empty for now
AgentFind: Search by agent name, or use the filter to find one by tag, owner or member. Searching this list doesn't search the messages inside an agent's chats.
AgentKnowledgeBase: Knowledge base holds the reference files available to the agent. Add the documents it needs when you have permission, and keep them relevant to the task.
AgentOutputs: Chat outputs brings together saved files produced while working with the agent. Open a result to review or edit it, with the access your role allows.
AgentRow: Click an agent's name to open its chat. Use Pin to top for the ones you use daily, and use the three dots to change the setup, invite people, or duplicate it for a similar job.
AgentRowMember: Open an agent to use the sections your role allows. With view-only access, you can read saved results in Chat outputs. Use the three dots to pin the agent or copy a link for someone who already has access.
AgentStart: Create an agent with a model and instructions for a recurring task. Add reference files to its Knowledge base, then open AI Chat to try a request and refine the setup.
AgentSwitchOn: The agents in this tour were examples. Enable AI agents & tools, then check the available models in AI settings to get your first agent ready.
AgentSwitchOnTitle: Switch it on and see for real
AgentWhatIsShared: An AI agent is an assistant configured for a task. Your role determines whether you can use its chat, add files to its Knowledge base or view saved results in Chat outputs.
